selected.name: ClickHouse
selected.rationale: An open-source, column-oriented OLAP database engine optimized for ultra-low latency analytical queries. It is ideal for storing and querying massive volumes of historical market data, such as sub-second real-time tick feeds and 20+ years of 1-minute OHLCV bars. Its vectorized query execution and custom compression codecs (like Gorilla and DoubleDelta) enable high-throughput batch ingestion and sub-second aggregations on billions of rows.

selected.name: TimescaleDB
selected.rationale: An open-source time-series database extension for PostgreSQL that automatically partitions data into time-based chunks (hypertables). It is uniquely suited for combining 20+ years of 1-minute equity bars and F&O data with complex relational metadata (such as corporate actions, AMFI mutual fund NAVs, and index compositions) while maintaining full SQL and PostgreSQL ecosystem compatibility.
